rules.name: JSON-LD Syntactic Validity
rules.description: JSON-LD scripts must be syntactically valid JSON with valid @context and @type.
rules.remediation: Validate structured data using Schema.org validator and resolve JSON syntax errors.

rules.name: Unified Entity Graph Interconnection
rules.description: Entities on the same page should link to one another using stable @id URIs (e.g. publisher, provider, isPartOf).
rules.remediation: Connect WebPage to WebSite, Service to Organization, and Author to Article via @id nodes.

rules.name: Offer Currency & Price Format
rules.description: Price must be formatted as numeric string (e.g. '0.00' or '29.99'), never text labels like 'FREE'.
rules.remediation: Set price to numeric value '0.00' with priceCurrency 'USD'.

rules.name: Person sameAs Authority Verification
rules.description: Authors should provide sameAs array linking to Wikidata, ORCID, LinkedIn, or GitHub.
rules.remediation: Add sameAs: ['https://orcid.org/...', 'https://linkedin.com/in/...'] to author Person nodes.
